expert_term.local: biegły (biegły sądowy when entered on a regional court list)
expert_term.en: expert appointed by the procedural authority (court, prosecutor or, in pre-trial proceedings, the investigating body)

appointment.basis: Kodeks postępowania karnego (Dz. U. 2026 poz. 490, consolidated text of 27.03.2026), art. 193, 194, 195
appointment.summary_en: Where findings of material importance require special knowledge, the procedural authority obtains an opinion of one or more experts (art. 193 § 1) or of a scientific or specialist institution (art. 193 § 2). Admission is made by a decision (postanowienie) naming the expert, the subject and scope of the examination with detailed questions where needed, and the deadline (art. 194). Besides listed court experts, any person known to have the relevant knowledge is obliged to act as expert (art. 195).

questions.summary_en: The authority defines the subject and scope of the examination and, where needed, formulates detailed questions (art. 194 pkt 2); it may change the scope or questions and put additional questions (art. 198 § 3). No KPK provision was found that expressly entitles the expert to decline individual questions outside the expertise or to report facts not asked about; replacement for doubts about knowledge or impartiality is under art. 196 § 3.

items_en: first name, surname, academic degree and title, specialisation and professional position of the expert
names and other data of other persons who took part in the examination, with the actions performed by each
for an institution's opinion: full name and seat of the institution
time of the examinations and date of the opinion
report on the actions performed and observations, and the conclusions based on them
signatures of all experts who took part in issuing the opinion
items_local: imię, nazwisko, stopień i tytuł naukowy, specjalność i stanowisko zawodowe biegłego
imiona i nazwiska oraz pozostałe dane innych osób, które uczestniczyły w przeprowadzeniu ekspertyzy, ze wskazaniem czynności dokonanych przez każdą z nich
w wypadku opinii instytucji – także pełną nazwę i siedzibę instytucji
czas przeprowadzonych badań oraz datę wydania opinii
sprawozdanie z przeprowadzonych czynności i spostrzeżeń oraz oparte na nich wnioski
podpisy wszystkich biegłych, którzy uczestniczyli w wydaniu opinii

rights_duties.summary_en: Persons excluded as witnesses or for judge-recusal grounds (art. 40 § 1 pkt 1-3 and 5), witnesses in the case and eyewitnesses cannot be experts; an opinion by an excluded expert is not evidence (art. 196 § 1-2). The expert takes the statutory promise of conscientiousness and impartiality; a listed court expert relies on the promise made on appointment (art. 197 § 1-2); witness rules incl. the warning on criminal liability (art. 190) apply (art. 197 § 3). Opinion is oral or written as ordered (art. 200 § 1); incomplete, unclear or contradictory opinions lead to re-examination or a new expert (art. 201). Unjustified absence or evasion of expert duties: monetary penalty up to PLN 3000, and for persistent evasion detention up to 30 days (art. 285 § 1, 287).

appointment.basis: Kodeks postępowania cywilnego (Dz. U. 2026 poz. 468, consolidated text of 27.03.2026), art. 278, 278^1, 290
appointment.summary_en: In cases requiring special knowledge the court, after hearing the parties on the number and choice of experts, may summon one or more experts (art. 278 § 1); it decides whether the opinion is oral or written (§ 3); if the court did not designate the person, the presiding judge does (§ 4). The court may admit an opinion commissioned by a public authority in other statutory proceedings (art. 278^1) or request an opinion of a scientific or research institute (art. 290).

questions.summary_en: The court's evidentiary decision names the means of evidence and the facts to be proven by it (art. 236 § 1). The court may order oral or written supplementation or explanation, or an additional opinion (art. 286). No KPC provision was found on the expert declining questions or reporting facts not asked about; the expert may refuse appointment on witness-refusal grounds or because of an obstacle preventing the opinion (art. 280 § 1).

items_en: statement of reasons (the opinion must contain a justification)
for an institute's opinion: the persons who carried out the examination and issued the opinion
items_local: W opinii instytutu należy wskazać osoby, które przeprowadziły badanie i wydały opinię.

rights_duties.summary_en: Refusal on witness grounds or for an obstacle (art. 280 § 1); party may seek exclusion on judge-recusal grounds until the expert's work ends (art. 281). Promise before starting; for written opinions it may be given by signing the promise text attached to the opinion; listed court experts rely on the promise made on appointment (art. 282). Fine for unjustified absence, refusal of promise or opinion, or delay (art. 287). Remuneration may be withheld until an unclear, contradictory or deficient opinion is corrected (art. 288 § 3). Witness rules apply otherwise (art. 289).

statute.title_local: Rozporządzenie Ministra Sprawiedliwości z dnia 24 stycznia 2005 r. w sprawie biegłych sądowych (Dz. U. 2005 nr 15 poz. 133), wydane na podstawie art. 157 § 2 ustawy – Prawo o ustroju sądów powszechnych
statute.title_en: Regulation of the Minister of Justice of 24 January 2005 on court experts (no separate statute on forensic expert activity; the regulation governs appointment of listed court experts by regional court presidents for 5 years, the appointment oath, duties and removal)

liability.norm: Kodeks karny (Dz. U. 2026 poz. 1342, consolidated text of 02.10.2026), art. 233 § 4, § 4a, § 5
liability.summary_en: An expert, appraiser or translator who presents a false opinion, expert report or translation intended as evidence in court or other statutory proceedings: imprisonment from 1 to 10 years (§ 4); unintentional act exposing the public interest to significant harm: up to 3 years (§ 4a). Extraordinary mitigation or waiver if immaterial to the outcome or voluntarily corrected before a decision (§ 5).
liability.warning_local: Uprzedzony(-a) o odpowiedzialności karnej z art. 233 § 4 Kodeksu karnego za przedstawienie fałszywej opinii mającej służyć za dowód w postępowaniu.
liability.warning_en: Having been warned of criminal liability under Article 233 § 4 of the Criminal Code for presenting a false opinion intended as evidence in proceedings.

liability.norm: KPK art. 197 § 1 (promise) with art. 197 § 3 and art. 190 § 1-2 (warning; in pre-trial proceedings a signed statement of having been warned)
liability.summary_en: Statutory promise taken by an expert who is not a listed court expert; the warning on criminal liability applies to experts by reference.
liability.warning_local: Świadomy znaczenia moich słów i odpowiedzialności przed prawem, przyrzekam uroczyście, że powierzone mi obowiązki wykonam z całą sumiennością i bezstronnością
liability.warning_en: Aware of the significance of my words and of my responsibility before the law, I solemnly promise that I will perform the duties entrusted to me with all diligence and impartiality.

liability.summary_en: Statutory promise in civil proceedings; fines for unjustified absence, refusal or delay. No codified special civil-liability rule for experts was found in KPC; general tort law is outside this research.
liability.warning_local: Świadomy znaczenia mych słów i odpowiedzialności przed prawem przyrzekam uroczyście, że powierzone mi obowiązki biegłego wykonam z całą sumiennością i bezstronnością
liability.warning_en: Aware of the significance of my words and of my responsibility before the law, I solemnly promise that I will perform the duties of expert entrusted to me with all diligence and impartiality.

liability.norm: Rozporządzenie MS z 24.01.2005 w sprawie biegłych sądowych, § 4, § 6
liability.summary_en: Disciplinary-type consequence: the regional court president dismisses a court expert who lost the conditions for the function and may dismiss for important reasons, in particular improper performance (§ 6). Oath on appointment in § 4.
liability.warning_local: Świadomy znaczenia mych słów i odpowiedzialności przed prawem przyrzekam uroczyście, że powierzone mi obowiązki biegłego sądowego wykonywać będę z całą sumiennością i bezstronnością
liability.warning_en: Aware of the significance of my words and of my responsibility before the law, I solemnly promise that I will perform the duties of court expert entrusted to me with all diligence and impartiality.

declaration.basis: KPC art. 282 § 1^1: an expert ordered to give a written opinion may make the promise by signing the promise text and attaching it to the opinion (not required for listed court experts, art. 282 § 1^2)
declaration.text_local: Świadomy znaczenia mych słów i odpowiedzialności przed prawem przyrzekam uroczyście, że powierzone mi obowiązki biegłego wykonam z całą sumiennością i bezstronnością
declaration.text_en: Aware of the significance of my words and of my responsibility before the law, I solemnly promise that I will perform the duties of expert entrusted to me with all diligence and impartiality.

esignature.law_local: Rozporządzenie (UE) nr 910/2014 (eIDAS) zmienione rozporządzeniem (UE) 2024/1183; ustawa z dnia 5 września 2016 r. o usługach zaufania oraz identyfikacji elektronicznej (Dz. U. 2024 poz. 1725, tekst jednolity)
esignature.law_en: Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 (eIDAS) as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1183; Act of 5 September 2016 on trust services and electronic identification (national implementing act)

timestamp.basis: Regulation (EU) No 910/2014, art. 41 (art. 41(3) deleted by Regulation (EU) 2024/1183; cross-border recognition now in art. 24a); no separate national presumption found in the Polish trust services act (its art. 133 only maps time stamps under the repealed 2001 e-signature act)
timestamp.qualified_recognition: A qualified electronic time stamp enjoys the presumption of the accuracy of the date and time it indicates and of the integrity of the data to which they are bound; non-qualified time stamps may not be denied legal effect or admissibility solely for being electronic or non-qualified.

open_questions: Customary formula of the warning under KPK art. 190 / KK art. 233 § 4 used in prosecutors' and courts' appointment decisions was not found in an official template; warning_local in the first liability entry is composed.

Whether a listed court expert, when filing a written opinion, should also attach the art. 282 § 1^1 promise text or only refer to the appointment oath (art. 282 § 1^2) - statute says the promise is not taken from listed experts; practice not verified.

PKN catalogue pages could not be fetched directly (TLS/403 from this environment); adoption numbers and current status of PN-EN ISO/IEC 27037/27041/27042/27043 were taken from search-engine extracts of sklep.pkn.pl and should be rechecked in the PKN catalogue.
Whether Polish courts or the police forensic laboratories require ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation for digital-forensics opinions remains unconfirmed; not listed.
Whether any 2025-2026 amendment to the trust services act (e.g. adapting to Regulation (EU) 2024/1183) was enacted after the 2024 consolidated text (Dz. U. 2024 poz. 1725) was not checked.
